Distribution. This species was previously recorded from Saudi Arabia by Pont (1991); Dawah & Abdullah (2009); El-Hawagry et al. (2017). It was described from Ethiopia. Biological remarks. The larvae of some species of Limnophora are aquatic, inhabiting running water. They prey mainly on oligochaetes and small insect larvae (e. g. psychodids, ceratopogonids etc.). Some species however, breed in dung or rotting fruit or decaying plant or animal matter (e. g. Limnophora quaterna Loew) (Gregor et al. 2002). They hatch in the second or third instar (Pont 1991).
